component.name: U-Stu Titles
component.summary: Design animated titles and lower thirds

description.p: U-Stu Titles designs the titles U-Stu Video Editor plays: lower thirds, name tags, chapter cards and overlays, over your own video. This is an early beta for testers.

ul.li: Text and shapes on a canvas with safe areas and snapping; type straight on the canvas
Fonts, colours, gradients, outlines and soft shadows, with the Unicorn Tears brand kit one click away
Titles fit any clip length in the editor: only the hold stretches
Export a title on its own for OBS: ProRes 4444, WebM or QuickTime Animation with a transparent background, a PNG sequence, or H.264

description.p: The first beta of the title designer.
